personal.headline: L2 Security Analyst & Primary Threat Hunter
personal.summaryLead: Dedicated Cyber Security Analyst and Primary Threat Hunter with a proven track record in complex incident response, proactive threat hunting, and cloud security investigations across global retail enterprise environments.
personal.summaryBody: Currently serving as an L2 Security Analyst managing end-to-end incident response, cloud exposure investigations, and threat hunting operations at Victoria's Secret (VS&Co). Demonstrated expertise in rapid malware analysis, SecOps automation, and leveraging CrowdStrike Falcon, Google SecOps, and Wiz to secure critical infrastructure and mitigate advanced threats. Backed by an NCSC-certified Master of Science (Distinction) in Cyber Security Engineering from the University of Warwick, hands-on CheriBSD memory-safety vulnerability research, and continuous live cyber range engineering.

pillars.title: Hypothesis-Driven Threat Hunting
pillars.desc: Designing custom queries and analytics across endpoint, identity, and cloud telemetry to hunt for advanced persistent threats (APTs) and evasive IOCs before alerts trigger.

pillars.title: Rapid Malware Analysis & IR
pillars.desc: Extracting malicious indicators during active security events and executing edge URI/domain blocks at the perimeter ahead of automated signature detection.

pillars.title: Cloud Security & Attack Paths
pillars.desc: Investigating complex cloud exposures, toxic combinations, and IAM privilege escalations utilizing Wiz, Cloudflare WAF, and Varonis DLP telemetry.

experience.role: L2 Security Analyst & Primary Threat Hunter
bullets: Primary Threat Hunter: Serve as the primary threat hunter for a Fortune 500 global retail enterprise, designing and executing proactive threat hunts across endpoint, identity, and cloud telemetry using CrowdStrike Falcon and Google SecOps to uncover advanced IOCs, TTPs, and APT activity.

End-to-End Incident Response: Manage the full incident response lifecycle beyond standard alert triage, successfully investigating and containing critical IR cases and suspected phishing and malware campaigns.

Cloud Exposure & Attack Paths: Conduct deep-dive cloud and attack surface investigations utilizing Wiz, Cloudflare, and Varonis to trace attack paths, assess cloud exposure, and remediate cloud-native security threats.

Perimeter Enforcement: Spearheaded rapid malware analysis during an active security incident, extracting malicious indicators and blocking URIs at the network edge prior to automated CrowdStrike EDR detections firing.

experience.company: University of Warwick · Cyber Security Centre
bullets: CheriBSD Vulnerability Research: Developed vulnerability proof-of-concepts in CheriBSD for automotive embedded systems using Lua and embedded C, simulating memory corruption and privilege escalation attacks to assess hardware compartmentalization effectiveness.

Threat Intelligence Observatory: Conducted threat intelligence research for emerging exploits in critical infrastructure and leveraged MISP and OpenCTI to analyze IOCs for enhanced incident detection.
Strategic Dashboards: Generated threat trend reports and analytical dashboards to support national security and strategic decision-making.

experience.company: TIAA GBS India · Global Financial Services
bullets: SecOps Automation: Automated third-party supplier risk assessment processes, drastically reducing supplier evaluation cycles from 2 weeks to 20 seconds and dramatically boosting audit throughput.
Log Analysis & SIEM Triage: Performed in-depth log analysis using Splunk to detect, triage, and investigate security incidents in a 24/7 global financial SOC environment.
CMMI Governance: Streamlined cybersecurity maturity assessments using the CMMI framework for improved senior leadership visibility.

experience.company: Larsen & Toubro EAIC · Industrial Engineering Enterprise
bullets: ISO 27001 Internal Audits: Conducted comprehensive ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS internal audits, identifying and remediating major security non-conformities across enterprise business units.
Employee Security Training: Designed training programs and educated 100+ employees in modern security hygiene, phishing mitigation, and governance policies.
